title: Ten years
summary: OpenAI reflects on ten years of progress, from early research breakthroughs to widely used AI systems that reshaped what’s possible. We share lessons from the past decade and why we remain optimistic about building AGI that benefits all of humanity.
body: OpenAI reflects on ten years of progress, from early research breakthroughs to widely used AI systems that reshaped what’s possible. We share lessons from the past decade and why we remain optimistic about building AGI that benefits all of humanity.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于公司成立十周年的回顾文章，总结了从早期研究到当前AI系统广泛应用的历程。文章重申了公司致力于构建造福全人类的通用人工智能（AGI）的愿景。
